cohort: 1124 pregnant women who underwent caesarean section at a tertiary healthcare center in Jammu and Kashmir.
finding: The most frequent indications for caesarean section were previous caesarean section (27.31%), nulliparous women with single cephalic presentation at >37 weeks gestation who were induced or had a caesarean section before labor (22.78%), and nulliparous women with single cephalic presentation at >37 weeks gestation in spontaneous labor (19.13%).
